instance origin: the dungeon and raid list marks each instance new in WoW: Forever or from the original game; the nine new dungeons confirmed by Warcraft Tavern's Forever dungeon announcement, the instance map IDs (2959-3065) by the client's DungeonEncounter table

points.name: Krol'dok Stronghold (outside portal)
points.note: Cave west of the fortress gates, northern Riverglades (guide: 37.5, 37.5; FDJ/OpenMap 37.5, 37.3).

points.name: Slavecrusher Grox
points.note: Patrols the quarry, down and right of the entrance.

points.name: Twilight Commander Zarmok
points.note: Patrols a compound by a large gate; pull from the left wall after the arena. Gate opens after he dies.

points.name: War Handler Ashka
points.note: Wolf pen past Zarmok, with wolves Snarlfang and Terrorhowl.

points.name: Tunk
points.note: Forge on the left curve; drops the Krol'dok Moulding quest item.

points.name: Zalfan Moonshadow
points.note: Up the road past Twilight Warlocks; needed for the quest Vengeance of the Highborne.

points.name: Nar'gurk
points.note: Ogre magi in a summoning circle at the top of the main path; carries the Tome of Twilight.

points.name: Bossman Toof
points.note: Endurance fight over two bridges with two Krol'dok Shamans; start by pulling the Centurions at the first bridge.

points.name: Overlord Mugg
points.note: Final boss in a house at the end of the long road; drops Eye of Mugg and the Ogre Key.

strategies.text: Pull from the leftmost wall after clearing the arena so you do not drag extra packs.
Treat it as an endurance fight over two bridges: stop at the first bridge for the Centurions, then push to Toof and his two shamans. Kill shamans first.
Two Centurions defend him; clear them first or tank them separately from Mugg.

notes: Order and route from the Warcraft Tavern guide (Forever). In-dungeon coordinates are not sourced anywhere I could read, so boss x/y are null. Quest NPC rows (floor 0) are OUTSIDE the dungeon: Riverglades map 2548 is assumed for all of them (the guide says Rom'gar and Farholde Keep; I did not verify they are on that map). Level range: client table says 40-47, news corrected to 40-45. Coordinates come from OpenMap (MIT), AllTheThings or web guides only; spots those lack are null. NeedRoll (GPL-3.0) was used only to cross-check; no values were copied.
